properties.title: Clinton Substation (AES Ohio)
properties.summary: AES Ohio 345/69 kV transmission substation and the delivery point for PJM M-3 Need Dayton-2025-002 — AES Ohio's disclosed customer request for 35 MW (1/2028) rising to 500 MW (1/2030) "in the vicinity of its Clinton Substation near Wilmington, OH" (PJM TEAC Dayton Supplemental, 2026-07-07). Eastern terminus of the ~29-mile Fayette–Clinton 345 kV line, OPSB 25-0871-EL-BLN (LON submitted 2026-03-19). A $65.4M expansion for the additional line, two customer feeds and a 300-MVAR capacitor is projected in service 2028-12-31, with two ~2-mile 345 kV feeds to an unnamed "customer substation" ($20M). The filing names a substation and a city, never a customer: the parcel is 53 m from the nearest Ardent/TAC petitioned-rezoning tract and 1.03 mi from the nearest AWS Cosler Farm holding, so the 500 MW is not attributable to either campus on the present record. Land: DP&L parcel 270-12-10-35-0000-00, 25.29 ac, Union Twp (Clinton County auditor CAMA).
